Name: The Holiest Fluffiness

Description: A tweak plugin born for the free company 'The Holiest Fluffiness', now open for all to enjoy.
Changelog:
New /hdebug command (also /hf hdebug): an htop-style monitor for figuring out what is eating your frames, CPU and memory.

The top shows CPU, memory, GPU and VRAM bars, plugin cost per frame with average FPS and 1% / 0.1% lows, and disk and network activity. When the CPU, GPU or VRAM is the bottleneck, that bar gets tagged, and hovering it explains why.

Tabs:
- Plugins: draw and update time per plugin, share of the frame, worst spike, hooks, texture memory and a texture trend line to spot leaks. Holiest Fluffiness itself is shown in gold, since part of its draw time is this window.
- Spikes: catches stutter frames and shows which plugin (or the game itself) caused each one.
- Threads: CPU per game thread and where it started from.
- Injected: overlays and other DLLs inside the game, like ReShade, Discord, Steam, RTSS and OBS.
- I/O: disk read/write and the game's network connections.
- Memory: process and .NET memory, garbage collection and history charts.

"Copy report" puts a summary on your clipboard, ready to paste into Discord when asking for help. Everything is read locally and only while the window is open.
